description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Occult and General Education checks.

Reaction: owning any Extra Skill with “Reaction” in its name gives you a second Defense each turn (automated). Once per scene, add +2 to a Occult and General Education check made outside your turn.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
